verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a REST API and an MCP server for agents, but nothing in the evidence describes scoped, permission-limited, or least-privilege API tokens. The generic 'simple and secure' pricing-page line and separate sandbox workspaces are adjacent features, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
